items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: And then we'll be like Celestine. What is Celestine? Celestine? Yeah, Celestine. Well he was on, he'd be on the books of silence too.

ctx.x: Early 20s. Early 20s. I'd say about 24. I'm not, I'm not much unremembered big. Well they had a few big bands. I think Celestan had a big band by then. Yeah, they had seven pieces I think. Celestan, I've heard him record on the television,

the radio since I learned that. Celestan had a nice band since you mentioned it. I think he had seven, eight pieces. And then another guy that had trumpet playing, had a nice band. Yeah. Manuel Perez. Yeah. Manuel Perez. Man, that's the one. He's had a very nice band. I remember saying that when I was down, when I get old he was going over, I could continue to play, because at that time he must have been 40 or so. Was he that old then? I didn't know. Well that's what I think, because I remember saying he played…
You say you met Piran in New York? Yeah, two Clance Williams. Oh yeah, well they used to have a kind of a music business together.
